name: Campingpark FiNK
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The FiNK Camping Park is located at the edge of Imst in the Upper Inn Valley, near the Lech River. The site provides direct access to hiking and biking trails. The area is characterized by alpine scenery, offering starting points for excursions to the Kaunertal and Ötztal. The terrain is terraced, featuring pitches for tents, campervans, and rental accommodations. Guests will find sanitary facilities, a small shop, and a dining area.
